STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: square plate, typical 20-30 cm. The plate looks like a standard large dinner square, so about 25-27 cm.
b) Reference: a chicken drumstick (11 cm) lies along the right edge. The plate spans roughly 2.5 drumstick-lengths across the width (about 420 px of plate versus about 130 px for the drumstick, roughly 3.2 lengths). Width ≈ 3.2 x 11 ≈ 26-27 cm. Alternatively, a pizza slice is about 11 cm wide and the two slices plus the drumstick span most of the top edge, consistent with ~26 cm.
Final width: 26 cm (square), area ≈ 676 cm².

- Chicken drumstick: one drumstick, about 11 cm, with a little sauce, countable item, about 90 g (with sauce, ~100 g). Use 95 g.
- Mound of dark seasoned item (possibly chicken/meat with breading or spice, roughly 5 x 4 cm, mound about 2 cm thick): footprint ≈ 20 cm² x average 1 cm (mound about half of 2 cm peak) = 20 ml x 1.0 = 20 g. Use 25 g with the sauce spread.
- Sauce smears on the drumstick and pizza are already included in the item weights.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: no base layer; the plate is largely empty, so no additional hidden items.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g (as served, cooked):
- Pizza (cheese and tomato, thin crust): about 250 kcal/100 g.
- Chicken drumstick (roasted, skin on, sauced): about 190 kcal/100 g.
- Seasoned meat mound: about 220 kcal/100 g.

Totals: pizza 210 g (≈525 kcal), drumstick 95 g (≈180 kcal), mound 25 g (≈55 kcal). Total ≈ 330 g, ≈760 kcal.
